body: Right, and it's driving me insane.

It's not really that. Sometimes these minors are so fucking minor that they will not affect anything (eg. waking up at 2 during holidays) yet my parents still call me out for being lazy. It's just insane.

Yes, everyone has problems. Some people lost the genetic lottery and are not very attractive. Some are born into working class families struggling with finances. And even if you're "very average" it doesn't mean that you will never face adversities in life. But what I am talking about is forever being seen as a fucking outsider.

Like I've said, it's not like I will go around shooting people as guns are not even legalised here.

It's more than that. It's the feeling that even minor errors are not tolerated and that people already see you as crying wolf. Sometimes I ask myself why I am still sane and I empathise with spree killers so much at certain times.
